card.name: Sentence-opening For and As in scripture
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "For" or "As" starting a quoted or sentence-initial clause in religious or scriptural text. Also fires on stray punctuation or digits inside numbers, such as the decimal point in a confidence interval.
